title: Terminal-Universe: Turning Agent Trajectories into Scalable Terminal Environments
task: Reconstructing executable terminal environments from agent trajectories for task synthesis and agent training
key_results: 37.3k task-sufficient environments created; 11.9 point improvement on Terminal-Bench 2.1, 13.8 point improvement on EvoCode-Bench v2 MT@4
comments: Clever approach to unlock scalable environment reuse from existing trajectories, though the completion agent's quality and generalization across diverse codebases merit further investigation.

model_io.model: trajectory replay + completion agent + task synthesizer

hypotheses.hypothesis: File operations in trajectories expose sufficient structure to reconstruct environments
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; 37.3k environments recovered

title: LLaDA-Image: Building Strong Image Generators with Fully Open Training Recipes
task: Building open-source high-quality image generation model with efficient training
key_results: State-of-the-art on Qwen-Image-Bench English (53.53) and Chinese (53.38) tracks; distilled Turbo variant enables 2-4 step inference
comments: Strong engineering of diffusion training with parameter-free RMSNorm and Muon optimizer, though the mix of 220M samples (only 98 real) raises questions about real-world generalization.

model_io.model: 6B Diffusion Transformer + frozen LLaDA2.0-Mini vision-language module

hypotheses.hypothesis: Image-only pre-training builds stronger visual prior than text-paired data from start
hypotheses.result: Validated through training progression

title: LatentPress: Context Compression Beyond Text and Vision
task: Compressing long conversational and document context into latent memory tokens for efficient LLM inference
key_results: 0.504 accuracy at 7.7× compression vs 0.490 uncompressed on LongMemEval; 43ms compression time (order of magnitude faster than text summarization)
comments: Elegant approach to machine-facing context representation, though zero-shot transfer from UltraChat→LongMemEval and generalization to truly novel domains remain limited.

model_io.model: small reader-matched writer adapter (4.2M-26.2M params) + frozen decoder
outputs: continuous memory tokens read via input-embedding interface

hypotheses.hypothesis: Continuous soft tokens enable more efficient compression than text/image representations
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; outperforms text summaries and OCR-based compression

title: Random Attention: Rethinking KV Cache Eviction for Efficient Reasoning
task: Efficient KV cache eviction during long-chain reasoning in LLMs
key_results: Uniform random eviction matches strongest prior eviction while achieving 32-43% higher throughput in vLLM deployment
comments: Surprisingly simple solution that challenges conventional wisdom on learned cache selection; the finding that prompt preservation matters most while reasoning traces are self-protecting via redundancy is insightful.

model_io.model: four decoder models with KV cache

hypotheses.hypothesis: Learned selection signals are unnecessary; redundancy in text and across heads protects reasoning traces
hypotheses.result: Confirmed across four models and six reasoning tasks

title: Why Gated DeltaNet Survives 4-Bit Quantization: NVFP4 W4A4 for the Recurrent Half of a Hybrid 27B LLM
task: 4-bit quantization of hybrid LLM recurrent layers without quality degradation
key_results: Matches BF16 performance across perplexity, MMLU-Pro, GSM8K, AIME'25, GPQA-Diamond with 17.5 GiB model (smallest and fastest prefill +14-19%); 32K perplexity gap shrinks with position
comments: Thorough mechanistic study explaining why supposedly fragile gating layers tolerate aggressive quantization, though results are specific to Qwen3.8-27B hybrid architecture.

model_io.model: NVFP4 W4A4 quantization on 496 linear/GDN layers of Qwen3.8-27B

hypotheses.hypothesis: Gate projections are least sensitive to quantization error due to softplus/sigmoid parameterizations
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; ~11% GEMM error compresses to ~2% output error

hypotheses.hypothesis: Recurrent state accumulation of errors does not compound over long context
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; state holds noise plateau and forgets impulses within hundreds of steps

title: Rethinking On-Policy Distillation of Large Language Models II: One Training Example
task: Understanding data efficiency and role of training data in on-policy LLM distillation
key_results: Single-query on-policy distillation recovers most full-data OPD gains after hundreds of steps; 16 semantically distinct queries reach 98.9% state coverage matching full-data training
comments: Valuable insight that OPD is data-overfed but algorithm-starved; however, the practical implications for production deployment remain unclear without compute-efficiency analysis.

model_io.model: student LLM with teacher rollout supervision

hypotheses.hypothesis: State coverage plateaus quickly while alignment continues for hundreds of steps
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; single query reaches 71.5% coverage within first 100 steps

title: Puffin-World: Scaling a Unified Multimodal Model with Native 3D World States
task: Unified multimodal 3D world generation with native physics, geometry, and appearance states
key_results: Puffin-16M dataset (15M vision-language-camera triplets, 1M trajectories); supports physically consistent world generation with closed-loop applications
comments: Ambitious integration of physics, geometry, and appearance generation, though quantitative benchmarks comparing to baselines on standard 3D generation tasks are absent.

model_io.model: Puffin-World multimodal architecture with Omni-Camera representation

hypotheses.hypothesis: Unified modeling of physics, geometry, and appearance enables better world generation than separate pipelines
hypotheses.result: Validated through closed-loop applications and dataset construction

title: Compile by Training: Turning Natural-Language Specifications into Local Neural Functions
task: Converting natural-language function specifications into deployable local neural functions via teacher-guided training
key_results: 83.6% semantic accuracy on FuzzyBench-Hard (subset where fast compiler failed); compiled functions run without teachers, storable and composable
comments: Practical bridge between natural-language intent and runnable code, though one-minute compile time limits applicability compared to few-second baselines.

model_io.model: compact interpreter with task-specific adapter

hypotheses.hypothesis: Teacher-generated examples enable effective training of compact adapters on frozen interpreters
hypotheses.result: Validated with 83.6% accuracy and deployed in interactive service

title: Knowing When Not to Reuse: Conditional Experience Transfer in Autonomous LLM Post-Training
task: Conditional reuse of past training evidence in autonomous LLM post-training across evolving domains
key_results: BCIT authorizes fewer harmful updates and achieves higher equal-budget final-model quality than alternatives on finance reasoning, text-to-SQL, and function calling
comments: Addresses real problem in repeated post-training, but evaluation limited to one 4B model and three domains; scalability to frontier models unclear.

model_io.model: autonomous post-training system with BCIT experience transfer

hypotheses.hypothesis: Past update effects are context-dependent and require applicability checks before reuse
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; BCIT prevents harmful updates while matching baseline quality

title: Editable Visual Design
task: Editable visual design generation combining VLM aesthetic judgment with coding agent layout control
key_results: System delivers editable artifacts with decoupled layers, real text, and iterative refinement; Agent Design Replay reproduces human designer trajectories
comments: Novel paradigm bridging creative vision and precise control, though no quantitative evaluation against design baselines or user studies demonstrating editing utility.

model_io.model: VLM (creative brain) + coding agent + image generation model (visual simulator)
outputs: editable HTML/CSS with decoupled layers and visual assets

hypotheses.hypothesis: Separating aesthetic judgment from code generation enables both refined aesthetics and production editability
hypotheses.result: Validated on posters and infographics with user-facing edits

title: Scal3R: Learning Efficient Multi-Relative Pose Query for Scalable Online 3D Reconstruction
task: Scalable online 3D video reconstruction using multi-reference relative pose queries
key_results: 60% reduction in average ATE on KITTI vs online baseline; state-of-the-art on Virtual KITTI, Sintel, TUM-Dynamic, ScanNet, 7-Scenes; convergence in 8 hours on single GPU
comments: Elegant solution to long-range drift by reformulating as relative pose queries; frozen backbone with learnable tokens (~1% params) is computationally efficient.

model_io.model: frozen reconstruction backbone + lightweight learnable query tokens via asymmetric attention + pose-graph optimization

hypotheses.hypothesis: Per-frame depth stability combined with relative pose queries prevents long-range drift in online reconstruction
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; 60% ATE reduction achieved

title: The Missing Temporal Link: Temporal Context Routing for Script-Driven Audio-Video Generation
task: Temporal alignment of scripts to jointly generated audio-video for script-driven content creation
key_results: Shot Boundary MAE reduced 96% (1.11→0.042 s); Dialogue Acc@0.5 s improved 55.8 pp (28.3%→84.1%); maintains visual quality and audio-visual sync
comments: Addresses critical gap in script-driven generation where modalities stay synchronized to each other but drift from script timeline; improvements are substantial.

model_io.model: Temporal Context Routing extending joint audio-video generator
outputs: synchronized video and audio with correct shot/dialogue timing

hypotheses.hypothesis: Routing script timing to shared temporal axis of video-audio enables precise shot and dialogue placement
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; 96% reduction in timing errors

title: Beyond Retrieval: Progressive Latent Memory Evolution for Streaming Video Understanding
task: Streaming video understanding with progressive latent memory evolution for user queries
key_results: State-of-the-art on online and offline video benchmarks; latent memory internalization replaces store-and-retrieve paradigm
comments: Shift from external to internal latent memory is conceptually appealing, though specific benchmark improvements and comparisons to retrieval baselines are not quantified in abstract.

model_io.model: LatentStream MLLM with hierarchical streaming memory + latent memory evolution

hypotheses.hypothesis: Internalizing historical evidence into compact latent tokens enables better streaming reasoning than external retrieval
hypotheses.result: Validated on online/offline benchmarks

title: CORE: Improving Compositional Reasoning in MLLM Embedding via Reranker Distillation
task: Compositional reasoning in MLLM embeddings via reranker distillation
key_results: CORE-EMBED-8B achieves 0.666 average on compositional benchmarks; CORE-RERANKER-8B scores 82.7% average (+10.7 pp over Jina); transfers to MCMR without sacrificing COCO/Flickr30K
comments: Well-motivated use of reranker distillation for fine-grained compositional distinctions; Rank-KL objective outperforms contrastive learning and CoSENT under same budget.

title: RealSWE: A Compositional Evaluation of Coding Agents under Realistic User Requests
task: Evaluating coding agents on realistic user requests vs curated GitHub issues
key_results: Real prompts 6.4 pp lower resolution rate on average; problem statements alone (88% of real prompts) appear in only 7% of benchmarks; desired behavior/motivation significantly affects performance
comments: Addresses important benchmark-reality gap; multi-variant task families enable controlled analysis of information and style dimensions.

inputs: user requests with varying information composition and linguistic style

hypotheses.hypothesis: Realistic inputs differ fundamentally from curated benchmarks in information composition and formality
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; 88% of real prompts are informal with minimal context vs 94% of benchmark problems formal

hypotheses.hypothesis: Explicit desired behavior and motivation improve agent performance more than environment/reproduction details
hypotheses.result: Confirmed via controlled analysis

title: PACE: Towards Surfacing Hidden Conflicts in User Requests
task: Identifying hidden conflicts between user requests and contextual constraints using multi-agent retrieval
key_results: PaceMaker outperforms baselines on implicit KB retrieval for conflict detection; multi-agent coordination across query reformulation, graph traversal, and conflict filtering improves retrieval and decision accuracy
comments: Addresses underexplored problem of context-aware refusal, though PACE dataset scale and domain coverage relative to other benchmarks are not specified.

model_io.model: multi-agent PaceMaker framework (query reformulation + graph traversal + conflict filtering)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Multi-hop retrieval from implicit KB enables better conflict detection than direct association
hypotheses.result: Validated; PaceMaker outperforms baselines on PACE

title: WorldReward: Reward Modeling for Camera-Conditioned World Models
task: Reward modeling for camera-conditioned world models via VLM-based pairwise preference evaluation
key_results: WorldReward exceeds GPT-5.5 on action consistency (+3.42 pp), appearance quality (+1.45 pp), motion quality (+3.56 pp); improves RL-trained HY-WorldPlay 1.5 across short-to-long horizons
comments: Unifies action-consistency and visual-quality evaluation via decomposition into chunks and voting; reasoning-augmented dataset with human refinement is substantial effort.

model_io.model: VLM-based pairwise preference model with action-aligned chunk decomposition

hypotheses.hypothesis: Structured VLM evaluation of action-aligned video chunks enables better reward modeling than monolithic video assessment
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; WorldReward beats GPT-5.5 on human-annotated WorldReward-Bench

title: FlashRender: Few-Step Generative Rendering via Camera-Controlled Video MeanFlow
task: Few-step generative video rendering along target camera trajectories
key_results: Matches multi-step baselines in quality and geometric consistency at 25× lower sampling cost; superior camera controllability even under out-of-distribution trajectories
comments: RETA + MeanFlow + on-policy flow distillation tackle discretization error from complementary angles; achieves significant speedup while maintaining quality.

model_io.model: diffusion-based video renderer with RETA and MeanFlow optimization
outputs: rendered video with new camera viewpoint

hypotheses.hypothesis: Representation alignment and mean-flow objective reduce discretization error, enabling effective few-step distillation
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; 25× sampling reduction without quality loss

title: Environment Evolution for Terminal Agents
task: Incrementally increasing terminal environment difficulty via off-policy evolution for agent training
key_results: Consistent production of harder environments; 14.4 pp improvement on Terminal-Bench 2.1 for Qwen3.6-27B, 18.0 pp for 35B-A3B via environment evolution + RL training
comments: Extends co-evolution paradigm by decoupling from on-policy rollouts, enabling continuous learning signals as model strengthens; mechanisms map to multi-turn learning objectives.

model_io.model: environment evolution harness (multi-agent loop) + RL training on evolved environments

hypotheses.hypothesis: Off-policy difficulty evolution provides more consistent learning signals than on-policy co-evolution
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; Hy4, Claude Opus 5, GPT-5.6 produce consistently harder environments

title: Principia: Relational Physics Tests for Video Models
task: Evaluating Newtonian physics reasoning in video generative models via relational object consistency
key_results: No model exceeds 0.42 on Principia despite 0.8 on VBench; vision-language models achieve only 67% accuracy detecting violations (near-chance for most)
comments: Novel calibration-independent consistency metric for relational physics is elegant; large gaps between aesthetics (VBench) and physics understanding are striking and concerning.

model_io.model: video generators (six state-of-the-art models) + VLMs for violation detection
inputs: paired objects obeying same physical law

hypotheses.hypothesis: Video generators can maintain aesthetic quality while failing relational physics consistency
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; Principia exposes physics failures missed by VBench

title: QCell: Recombining and Aligning Cell Queries for Overlapping Instance Segmentation
task: Instance segmentation of overlapping cells in microscopy via query recombination and alignment
key_results: +2.2 AP and +2.7 AJI on ISBI2014; outperforms state-of-the-art across multiple benchmarks; new Organoid dataset introduced
comments: Query-based approach with latent recombination addresses practical segmentation challenge; contrastive alignment encourages separation of overlapping instances.

model_io.model: QCell query-based segmentation with instance recombination and contrastive alignment

hypotheses.hypothesis: Latent recombination and contrastive alignment enable better de-overlapping than local ROI or shape-prior approaches

title: Select, Compress, Reinvest: A Controlled Study of Visual-Token Allocation in Long-Video MLLMs
task: Controlled analysis of visual-token allocation and selection strategies in long-video MLLMs
key_results: Query-selected 8 frames beat uniform 16 by 6.9 pp on LongVideoBench hour-long bin; Orthogonal Matching Pursuit matches purpose-built selectors; compression is near-free (+0.44 pp cost), reinvestment yields +2-3 pp
comments: Rare controlled single-harness comparison exposing implementation bugs and harness differences; OMP's competitiveness challenges recent selector work.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Query-aware selection is strongest lever; compression is free but only pays off if savings reinvested in more frames

title: Let Confidence Change, Not the Prediction: Prediction-Preserving Repair for Post-hoc Calibration
task: Post-hoc calibration of multiclass predictions while preserving top-1 decision
key_results: Zero prediction change by construction (TPCR); lowers mean ECE, NLL, Brier vs direct calibrated outputs across CIFAR-10/100 and ImageNet-1K; gains persist under distribution shift
comments: CORD solves exact prediction preservation without additional learnable parameters; elegant repair approach that unbundles calibration-fitting from decision recovery.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Exact prediction preservation can be achieved via output repair without constraining calibrator fitting

title: Percolation Dynamics in Optimization : Variance Cascades and Discrete Scale Invariance
task: Understanding SGD dynamics as percolation process driving subnetwork emergence in neural networks
key_results: Variance spikes register architectural symmetry merges in discrete blocks; scaling cascades extend to Adam/AdamW under heavy-tailed noise
comments: Theoretical perspective linking SGD dynamics to phase transitions via percolation; mechanism explanation for subnetwork emergence during training.

model_io.model: SGD and Adam/AdamW on deep neural networks

title: Using Grounded Theory for Agent Behavior Analysis at Scale

title: The membrane-to-cortex distance regulates mDia1 activity to control cortical mechanics
task: Determine how membrane-to-cortex distance regulates formin activity and cortical mechanics
key_results: Membrane-to-cortex distance reduction controls mDia1 activity and decreases cortical tension in a density- and length-dependent manner; nanometer-resolution mapping of cell surface organization achieved via cryo-electron tomography

In-cell cryo-electron tomography

title: Opening threshold and kinetics of the MscL mechanosensitive channel are regulated by its periplasmic loop
task: Elucidate the role of the periplasmic loop in MscL mechanosensitive channel gating
key_results: Periplasmic loop mutations (A64, Q65, G66, D67) alter channel opening threshold and kinetics; Q65E produces larger but structurally restricted conformational changes with slower pore opening; Q65R increases sensitivity in azolectin but not negatively charged liposomes
comments: The study elegantly demonstrates loop-mediated electrostatic fine-tuning of gating, though the lipid-dependent modulation of Q65R sensitivity suggests context-dependent mechanisms warrant further investigation.

model_io.model: MscL channel variants in giant E. coli spheroplasts
MscL channel variants in liposomes (azolectin or negatively charged lipids)
Molecular dynamics simulations of MscL variants

hypotheses.hypothesis: Periplasmic loop mutations disrupt mechanical force transmission to the pore
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; loop extension and electrostatic alterations reduce channel sensitivity and alter kinetics

hypotheses.hypothesis: Q65 electrostatic properties modulate lipid interactions controlling gating
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; Q65R sensitivity depends on lipid charge; Q65E exhibits reduced sensitivity and flickering

hypotheses.hypothesis: Wild-type MscL undergoes rapid extensive pore opening compared to Q65E
hypotheses.result: Confirmed by MD simulations; Q65E restricted conformational changes, slower opening kinetics

title: Functional characterization of snoRNA-derived RNA (sdRNA) expression in healthy hematopoiesis and acute myeloid leukemia

Target validation

title: Therapy induced senescence promotes immunogenicity in acute myeloid Leukemia through reduced EZH2 activity

PRC2 inhibition in non-senescent AML

Behavioral memory assay

RNA sequencing

title: Deep learning-based pathomics reveals renal tubular atrophy with inflammatory cell infiltration as a prognostic marker in IgA nephropathy
